decision: Accept the exact dated articles for local source integration; production acceptance remains pending

records.determination: Count the named West Metro extension once across its two delivery phases. Do not count each station, depot, entrance or parking asset separately, or duplicate Helsinki's existing municipal account. Espoo is a distinct receiving municipality, while the ownership and operating organizations remain institutional context rather than new project identities.

Count Espoo once as a municipality separate from the already counted Helsinki municipality. Explain shared regional services without assigning their full totals to Espoo or counting the HSY catchment as another place. Company buildings, childcare services and individual transport stations illustrate local systems but do not create additional place identities.

Count Tampere once within its municipal boundary, preserving the wider wastewater service catchment as regional context. Do not count its district housing proposal, playground or treatment plant as additional projects in this group, and do not extend the place boundary to all neighboring municipalities served by the plant.

review_checks: Identity screening found an existing Helsinki municipal account but no West Metro, Espoo or Tampere dossier. Count one railway project and two municipalities; keep Helsinki linked without counting it again. No historical acquisition docket is reused.

Seventeen official HTML bodies or scoped segments were inspected November 22: eleven English, five Finnish and one Swedish. The English HSY abstract includes Finnish publication metadata; the Climate Watch action has Finnish substantive text within an English interface. Interpretation is author/AI self-review, not independent language review.

Three articles contain 562, 571 and 582 body words, eighteen sections and twenty chronology events. Each has five source-bound sections and a labelled editorial evidence test. No new translated-reading identities are created.

West Metro's two phases belong to one project. The owner's dated lifecycle account supports November 2017 for the first opening; the Swedish phase-two account supports December 3, 2022. Conflicting indexed 2023 opening wording from another operator page was not adopted.

March 19, 2018 is plan approval, not expenditure or an opening. The €1,159 million budget is a revised planning envelope, not final audited cost. Phase-two cost-table forecasts were excluded. An Espoo meeting page returned a decoding error and was not used.

Governance, HSL scheduling and maintenance roles remain separate. City-area cost allocation is not share ownership; no percentages or current individual officeholders are inferred. A century-scale outlook is not every component's design life.

Keilaniemi heat savings of 258 MWh versus a 374 MWh target and electricity savings of 155 MWh versus 102 MWh refer to 2025 after autumn 2024 work. They remain owner-reported station-property results, not traction energy, weather-normalized proof or city-wide climate causation.

The July 16 Tapiola notice was read on the official category page. The standalone article returned a cache miss. Staggered July–August closures and announced lift alternatives are a historical schedule, not verified completion or November equipment availability.

Espoo's precise 48% regional reduction and 72% per-resident reduction refer to 1990–2025, not identical denominators. Coal heat ended in April 2024 according to the later account. Consumption elsewhere is outside that inventory; no causal credit is assigned solely to West Metro.

HSY's 138.5 million cubic metres covers two plants, not Espoo alone. Blominmäki's third full year and 53% electricity self-sufficiency remain plant-specific. Permit compliance is an operator abstract claim; full technical chapters and permit records were not inspected.
Espoon Asunnot distinguishes subsidized and privately financed housing; priority and three-month application validity do not promise an offer. No applicant data or eligibility decision was submitted.

Espoo's four free weekday childcare hours for five-year-olds are not full-day universal provision. The August 19 processing-delay notice is not a verified November backlog or completed remediation. Fee effective dates remain distinct from publication.

Climate Watch's 130-property intervention, reported 16–20% reductions and estimated 2025 savings retain company/property scope. The February update does not date all installations. Planned 2026–2028 work for 7,500 apartments is not completed delivery.

Tampere's November 16 approval and November 17 release concern the future 2027 budget. City and subsidiary investment scopes remain separate. Metsäniitty yard improvements, the unfinished final area and ongoing THL monitoring are not collapsed into a measured health benefit.

Sulkavuori's first-year cumulative 28 million cubic metres covers six municipalities. Capacity, cumulative volume, pollutant assessment periods and planned 2027 odour monitoring remain distinct; no independent calendar-2026 audit or bathing-water certification is claimed.

Kaupinlaakso I's legal plan and II's public-review proposal are separate; planned residents, future tram access and service layout are not occupied housing. Tampere's retained 2024 childcare schedule is not mixed with 2026; update and effective dates differ.

Linked files, forms, maps, PDFs and live services were not tested. All prior cohorts, 34 readings and evidence decisions are retained. Production verification, release authority, launch and thirty real operating days remain separate.
